item: Weather context in the encrypted store (R683) and climate review fixes
refs: PR #1967; R683; Lane F review rows 17 19 20 21
key_paths: src/weather/openmeteo.py; src/api/weather.py; src/static/app-home.js; src/static/app-claim.js; src/static/app-climate.js; src/stats/fetch.py; src/stats/climate.py; src/api/main.py
summary: The Home card and Claim Workspace weather fetch get the R675 treatment: the place is rounded to 0.1 degree (one arithmetic shared with the page, ties up) before it is sent or kept; every slice lives in the encrypted app_state table; the plaintext weather_context folder is deleted at startup; POST /api/weather/context refuses without consent (400) and under the kill switch (409) but answers a held slice locally; every request asks first, naming the rounded place and the host. Climate: the Source link opens the local preview first; Fetch fails closed without the consent popup; Stop ends a download under way; an area a whole-file dataset drops is counted as withdrawn.
